description: 【名古屋市】令和元年度新幹線鉄道騒音・振動定期監視結果等について(令和2年2月3日公表) [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 名古屋市. 令和元年度の新幹線鉄道騒音・振動定期監視結果及び平成27年度から令和元年度までの新幹線鉄道騒音・振動定期監視結果の推移をまとめています。. Coverage: 名古屋市. The portal files it under the publisher 名古屋市. Its tags are 名古屋市, 定期監視, 振動, 新幹線, 騒音. It offers 5 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2024-11-11 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
